title: agentgw ledger checkpoint
description: A checkpoint line in the JSONL ledger, appended every ledger.checkpoint_every entries or on demand. Same canonical form, prev_hash and sig rules as ledger-entry. root is the Merkle root over the entry lines (type=entry only) appended since the previous checkpoint: leaves are line_hash of each entry in file order; each level pairs adjacent nodes left-to-right as SHA-256(left || right) of the raw 32-byte hashes; an unpaired last node is carried up unchanged; a single-entry range has root = its line_hash. The checkpoint participates in the chain: the next line's prev_hash is this line's line_hash. Version 1.

range.description: The entries covered: from first_id to last_id inclusive, count of them. Never empty; Checkpoint with no new entries is a no-op.
